## ForgeLoop protocol change checklist

- [ ] Task contract and scope are stated.
- [ ] Persisted artifact/schema compatibility impact is stated.
- [ ] Transaction, lock, and recovery impact is stated.
- [ ] CLI metadata and generated docs are current.
- [ ] Valid and invalid conformance evidence is included.
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run docs:check`, and `npm run pack:check` passed.
- [ ] No secrets or unverified external publication claims were added.
